entry.title: BIP 119 CTV activation client
entry.summary:
Reproducibility is essential when demonstrating the effectiveness of a particular transaction mechanism. For instance, in scenarios involving high transaction fees, it is important to publish the exact setup used in any demonstration. This approach ensures that others can replicate the results and evaluate the findings independently.
A meaningful comparison should include metrics such as on-chain weight and transaction fees, measured against the best alternative constructions that do not utilize CTV. The analysis must account for all transactions involved, including setup and potential recovery procedures. This comprehensive evaluation is necessary to determine if CTV genuinely alters the economic landscape for users, rather than merely confirming its technical feasibility.
The apparent lack of objections to certain parameters within a single mailing-list thread should not be interpreted as a sign that the community is ready to adopt the change. Broader consensus requires more thorough engagement and validation beyond isolated discussions.
